title: Micro Finance Industry
description: Comprehensive ERP solutions designed for microfinance institutions, optimizing loan management, client servicing and financial operations while ensuring regulatory compliance and social impact tracking.

infoCards.title: Loan Management
infoCards.description: Streamlined loan processing and portfolio tracking system for efficient microfinance operations.

infoCards.title: Field Operations
infoCards.description: Integrated field operations and client management system for microfinance institutions.

faqData.question: How does the system handle loan management?
faqData.answer: Our system provides end-to-end loan management including application processing, disbursement tracking, repayment scheduling, collection management and portfolio monitoring with detailed analytics.

faqData.question: What client management features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes comprehensive client management with KYC verification, credit history tracking, group management, social impact assessment and mobile-based field operations support.

faqData.question: Can it handle regulatory compliance?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution ensures compliance with microfinance regulations including reporting requirements, interest rate calculations, documentation management and audit trail maintenance.
